one_liner: Agentic enterprise data management platform — helps enterprises trust their data for AI pipelines.
stage: Series A ($30M, led by Plural — March 5, 2026)
why_pp: Validio deploys AI agents that touch production enterprise data. Every agent action — data validation, pipeline mutation, automated remediation — needs a verifiable authorization receipt before it fires. Without PP-style enforcement, one misconfigured agent can corrupt the data layer they're selling trust on top of. This is a 'secure the foundation' pitch: they sell data trust, PP makes the agents executing on that data trustworthy.
best_approach: Congratulate on funding. Position PP as the authorization layer for their agentic pipelines — 'you're building trust in data, we help you extend that trust to the agents touching it.'
urgency: high — fresh funding = expansion, new hires, new integrations window
